full_text:
Oddrey 2 is a Gaia-Titan which resembles a Venus flytrap. It was created by Klaus as one of his experiments. His first attempt, Oddrey 1, tried to eat Klaus and therefore was not a success.

== Abilities ==
Oddrey 2 is able to devour things easily and can trap small Titans, such as Cherit or Springer, in its cage-like mouth. It can also overgrow plants and immobilize its enemies.

== Gallery ==

Oddrey 2 Icon.png|Oddrey 2's Icon

== Trivia ==
* Oddrey 2's name and appearance are based on Audrey II, an evil extraterrestrial Flytrap plant from Little Shop of Horrors. This Titan's appearance heavily reflects traits of the Venus Flytrap.
* This is one of the few evil Gaia-Titans. The others are Gawain (which became corrupted due to the polluted river) and Tolivane (if used by an evil Seeker).
